**Is your feature request related to a disaster recovery problem?**
A clear description of what the failure mode is (e.g. "When X fails during disk recovery...").

**Describe the proposed solution**
Describe the built-in command, syntax, and behavior you would like added to `shell.c`.

**Why should this be built-in rather than an external tool?**
Explain why this tool is essential when external binaries (`/usr/bin`) or package managers are unavailable.

**Additional context**
Any architectural constraints, system calls, or procfs paths relevant to this feature.
